gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-chivo: Chivo packs its lowercase tight up toward the caps. Love Ya Like A Sister has a marker-drawn plainness in every character, and that scrawled bluntness against Chivo's daylight-filled curves is what you remember.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-chocolat: A sizable lowercase and a broad-nibbed pen stroke that never curls shut make Chocolate Classical Sans read large and open. Love Ya Like A Sister counters with arches that match its stems.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-comme: Comme reads smoothly, its curves never clogging and its lowercase filling most of the letter height. And a steady pen pressure in Love Ya Like A Sister hands off to Comme below.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-cossette: Expressive yet level, Love Ya Like A Sister keeps its ascenders barely above the x-height. Cossette Texte carries the paragraphs with wide-eyed e forms and a prominent x-height, so text keeps moving without snagging.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-duru-san: Loud and unmodulated: Love Ya Like A Sister never swells or thins a stroke. Duru Sans fills the line beneath with wide openings and dominant lowercase, so the bold heading has solid ground.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-fresca: Fresca keeps its ascenders short above big bowls. Its connected counters and lack of calligraphic thinning mean text flows steadily down the page, while Love Ya Like A Sister handles the loud part.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-funnel-s: Funnel Sans holds its stroke widths steady from stem to curve, with an e opened like a pried clasp. But Love Ya Like A Sister is the louder voice, and that gap is the draw.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-gafata: Gafata stacks a tall band of letters beneath short stalks. Love Ya Like A Sister, traced as if with one marker, gives it a bold hand up top while the wide-eyed e forms keep the text open.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-geist: Love Ya Like A Sister keeps a quiet, level beat, ascenders barely clearing the x-height. Geist turns paragraphs into solid blocks rather than skylines, its wide-open forms keeping each line easy on the eye.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-georama: Georama reads wide and friendly, with a c pulled open like a bracelet and capitals that barely rise. Love Ya Like A Sister counters with rope-like stems, bowls and tails.
